title: Astronomy
tagline: What the light tells us, across forty powers of ten.
intro: Astronomy starts here with practice: a ladder of four levels from first problems to olympiad problems, then three topic sets that move outwards from the Solar System to the whole universe. Every problem has a full worked solution, written so you can learn the method from it. Lessons for each topic will follow, and the problems will stay as their practice.

1.title: The ladder
1.blurb: Four levels of problems, from basics through intermediate and advanced to olympiad. Climb in order.
